not_found_description: The link may be mistyped or incomplete.
route_error_description: We couldn't show this screen. Start the charge again.
invalid_charge_description: The link is missing the amount or has been changed. Create the charge again.
charge_form_description: Enter the amount to generate the payment QR code.
charge_form_concept_hint: Optional. The student sees it when paying.
amount_invalid: Enter a valid amount, for example 1.20.
amount_not_positive: The amount must be greater than 0.
charge_qr_listen_error: We stopped listening for the payment. If the student has already paid, it will show up when you retry.
metrics_empty: Here you'll see how the payments you collect on this device are detected.
metrics_median_hint: How long checking the payment takes once detected: median
metrics_p95_hint: 95% of payments are checked in this time or less
metrics_via_notification_hint: The RPC reported the payment through the subscription: the fast path
metrics_via_look_back_hint: The notification didn't arrive or arrived late: the every-second check found it
metrics_footnote: Times are how long a payment takes to be checked once detected. The last 50 charges are kept.
